# LearnIndia — Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 2026

## 1. Information We Collect

We collect the following information when you register:
- Full name
- Email address
- Phone number
- Course enrollment details
- Learning progress data

## 2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:
- Provide personalised learning experiences
- Track your course progress
- Issue completion certificates
- Send course updates and reminders

## 3. Data Sharing

We do not share your personal data with advertising
or analytics companies.
